reason: The README clearly describes a multimodal media plugin offering image understanding and OCR, audio transcription, and text-to-image generation through Qwen APIs, with local file output and optional verification.

summaries.zh: 通过 Qwen API 为文本模型提供图像理解与 OCR、音频转写和文本生成图像工具。
summaries.en: Provides Qwen-powered tools for image understanding and OCR, audio transcription, and text-to-image generation for text-based models.

capabilities: Understands images, screenshots, OCR content, and charts through Qwen VL APIs
Transcribes audio files through Qwen3-ASR APIs
Generates images from text through Qwen-Image APIs
Writes generated images to local files and can invoke bundled Python scripts
Optionally verifies generated images against the prompt using image understanding
